workarounds.note: retint() rewrites the hex of every palette-linked colour from the colourway before each build: 1.4.1 leaves design-slot elements (the band, the waveform bars, the opener type, the running head and the folio pill) and bodyText.referenceColor at the hex written beside their paletteId (gotcha palette-skips-designs); without relink() the teal edition prints all of them in the red edition's colours

bodyText.boldColor is set with the palette id deep and the tickets box sets no body.boldColor, so the box copies the linked colour and its bold follows every colourway; with bodyText.boldColor unset, 1.4.1 copies the main-color default into the box, and in the teal edition its bold printed #295AA3 while the bold outside it took the band (gotcha palette-skips-designs)
the ragged samples keep '**Quay Stage**,' and '**Escenario del Muelle**,' mid-line in both editions, and a bold time is always followed by a chip, never by punctuation (gotcha ragged-run-punctuation)
ragged listings get no runt control in 1.4.1: both samples are reworded until every item and box ends on two words or more (gotcha ragged-runts)
the H1 restates breakBefore because a headings object drops it (gotcha headings-drop-h1-break)
resourceTypes: defaultResourceTypes(LANG), so the grid's caption reads 'Tabla 1' in Spanish (gotcha resource-types-locale)
the opener's title and standfirst give lineHeight as a multiple (gotcha design-lineheight-multiple)
